info.name: Facilities Helpdesk API (core)
info.description:
Every route of the core service. Run the whole collection top to bottom: each request saves what the next ones need (accessToken, ticketId, ...) into collection variables.

Point `baseUrl` at your API (default: local Uvicorn). Auth is `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`, set once at collection level; **Login** saves the token. The Admin folder needs an existing admin account: set `adminEmail` and `adminPassword`. Full reference: postman_testing.md.
